## Purpose

`@abyss/base-config`: the one source of the formatting and lint rules. Each app and package extends it with its own plugins ([global rules](../../global/RULES.md) "Shared tooling", "Naming").

## Techniques

Built with `tsc` to `dist/` (ESM plus `.d.ts`); exports point at `dist/`, so it must be built before any consumer task (turbo does it). The ESLint rule `abyss/file-names` checks the naming rule of ADR 0008: shape, kebab-case folders, the `use` prefix against one exported hook, a repeated word, the required word, test suffixes.

## Technologies

Prettier, ESLint flat config, Oxlint.

## Entry points

Package exports `./prettier`, `./eslint`, `./oxlint`; `baseEslint({ fileNames })`.

## Where to change what

A shared rule: the matching `*.setup.ts`; a project-only rule stays in that project's config. File-name checks: `FileNames.eslint.ts` (options per package).
